![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14057099/assets/e41579712730d26c66d9f46f8d978fd51c8efbd76394c094113454e24b3aaff7.png)

Calculate ${\int }_{C}\,\text{d}s,$ where $C$ is the line segment shown above.
worked_solution:
The line integral of unity with respect to arc length over $C$ is equal to the arc length $L$ of $C,$ i.e.,

$$
{\int }_{C}\,\text{d}s=L.
$$

In this case, the path $C$ is the hypotenuse of a right triangle whose legs have lengths $2$ and $4:$ 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14057099/assets/849f44d06de55f14811d433f9ccfdd30d47f6a1db1970cdfbfbd6f16be4959b0.png)

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}L & =\sqrt{{2}^{2}+{4}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{4+16} \\  & =\sqrt{20} \\  & =2\sqrt{5}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
{\int }_{C}\,\text{d}s=2\sqrt{5}.
$$
